species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 48°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 10–48 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 75 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 110 ft, so fish stay above it.
